🌍 Macro & earnings this week

  • Treasury yields spiked: the 10-year briefly hit 5.23%, the highest since June 2007; the 30-year briefly 5.53% and the 2-year topped 4.90%. Strong manufacturing surveys on Wednesday were one catalyst. (CNBC, 25 Sep)
  • Growth over cyclicals: the Dow, financials and small caps lagged while the Nasdaq Composite, the Magnificent Seven and semiconductors advanced. (CNBC, 25 Sep)
  • 30-year fixed mortgage rate jumped to 7.45%, highest in more than two years (Mortgage News Daily). (CNBC, 25 Sep)
  • S&P Global flash manufacturing PMI jumped to 57.0 in September (from 53.9), the strongest improvement in conditions since May 2022. (Newsquawk week-ahead)
  • Friday close: S&P 500 +1.2% and Nasdaq +2% on the week (Nasdaq record close Tuesday); Microsoft +3.7% led; CME FedWatch ~66% odds of a 25bp+ October hike; Brent stayed above $100. (Reuters close wrap, 25 Sep (via FinTwit news-wrap), via FinTwit)
  • UMich final September sentiment 48.1 (four-month low); 1-year inflation expectations rose to 4.6% from 4.0%. (Reuters, 25 Sep (via FinTwit news-wrap), via FinTwit)

Reported this week (desk universe): BB Thu EPS YoY n/a (loss), surprise +75%, earnings score 57→74; SNX Thu EPS +88% YoY, surprise +21%, earnings score 76→68
